function: Learns CSI compression at the UE and reconstruction at the BS (encoder-decoder with dilated convolutional and multihead attention), plus an attention denoising block for noisy feedback codewords (pp. 4-6).
system: FDD massive MIMO, single user; BS with 32 antennas, UE with 1 antenna, 1024 subcarriers; indoor 5.3 GHz and outdoor 300 MHz; no RIS (pp. 3, 6).
method: Attention autoencoder (dilated convolution plus multihead attention) trained end to end on NMSE reconstruction loss, i.e., target is input CSI; denoising block with pretraining then alternating training (pp. 4-7).
data_channel: COST 2100 dataset: indoor 5.3 GHz and outdoor 300 MHz, 150,000 samples split 100,000 train, 30,000 validation, 20,000 test; Gaussian noise added on the feedback link (p. 6).
test_conditions: Held-out COST 2100 test split for indoor and outdoor scenarios and four compression ratios (1/4-1/32); feedback-SNR mismatch tests train at one SNR, test at others; antenna-failure test (pp. 6-10).
baselines: Learned only: CsiNet, CRNet, CLNet, ACRNet1x, CCA-Net-L, CRIssNet-M, CsiNet+, Attn-CSI, KANsformer, others; DNNet for denoising; perfect-CSI bound for SE; no classical method (pp. 7, 11-12).
metrics: NMSE (dB), cosine similarity rho, FLOPs and MAC operations, parameters, inference time, spectral efficiency (bps/Hz) (pp. 7-12).
complexity: FLOPs 3.08M-4.91M (Table II); UE and BS parameters, MACs and inference time 0.0029-0.0036 s per compression ratio (Table III), pp. 7-8.
openness: No code released; uses the COST 2100 dataset also used by [13], no link given (p. 6).
q1_support: p. 6: "the dataset generated by COST2100 [44] is utilized" for the indoor 5.3 GHz and outdoor 300 MHz scenarios.
q2_support: p. 9: "the MANet trained at a specific SNR when evaluated under different SNR conditions" is an SNR sweep; p. 10: "We introduce partial or complete antenna failures in the training data"; indoor and outdoor are evaluated separately, with no cross-scenario test.
q3_support: p. 7: "categorized into large DL models and small DL models" (Table II lists only learned methods); p. 12: Fig. 10 compares CsiNet, CLNet, CRNet and a Perfect CSI bound; LASSO, TVAL3 and AMP are only named in the introduction (p. 1), never compared.
q4_support: p. 7: "FLOPS were employed to assess the computational overhead" (Table II: 4.91M, 3.87M, 3.34M, 3.08M for MANet); p. 8: Table III gives parameters, MAC and inference time (0.0036 s at 1/4).
q5_support: p. 6: "the dataset generated by COST2100 [44] is utilized to compare the proposed MANet with several other networks, all of which are assessed using the same dataset [13]"; the paper itself gives no link or code release.
notes: Included, area 2 (CSI compression and feedback). q5 is a flag for the reviewer: the paper names no link and does not say the data are public, but the COST 2100 data are said to be the same dataset as the benchmark of [13] (p. 6); confirm it is public, else q5 is 0. q3 is 0 because the only non-learned item is the perfect-CSI upper bound in Fig. 10 (p. 12), which is not a feedback method. q2 is 0: SNR mismatch sweeps do not count and antenna failures are simulated in the training data (p. 10). Tables II to VIII were read from the page images (pp. 7-10).
